name: How do I know if my exterior carpentry needs repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my exterior carpentry needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for visible signs of damage such as cracked, peeling, or blistering paint, soft or crumbling wood, discolored areas, or gaps and holes. Rotting wood is a common indicator, often found near rooflines, window frames, or where wood meets the ground. Early detection of these issues can prevent more extensive and costly repairs down the line. A thorough visual inspection of your home's exterior can help you identify areas needing attention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for cracked paint, soft wood, discoloration, or gaps, especially near rooflines and windows. Early detection helps prevent bigger problems.
